Name: EAC LifeTraces
Author: smile0817
Description:
[center]
[color=#8F7144]❧ ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ❧[/color]

[size=6][b][color=#E6BC72]鹈鹕镇百闻本[/color][/b][/size]

[color=#B7C8B1]EAC LifeTraces[/color]

[color=#8F7144]❧ ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ❧[/color]

[size=4][b][color=#F0D59A]先有真实发生的生活，再有被记录下来的故事。[/color][/b][/size]

[i][color=#AABBCD]Life happens first. The story is written afterward.[/color][/i]

[color=#725D3E]· · ─────── ✦ ─────── · ·[/color]

[size=5][b][color=#D9A85D]✦  你是不是也有过这种感觉？  ✦[/color][/b][/size]

[b][color=#98AEC4]Have you ever felt this way?[/color][/b]

[color=#EEE7DC]你在农场里忙了一整天。清晨砍树，午后钓鱼，路过杂货店买了一袋种子，又在回家前顺手送出一份礼物。你和鹈鹕镇的居民走过同一条路、参加过同一个节日，有时甚至在彼此身边停留了很久。可是第二天见面时，一切依然像从未发生。[/color]

[color=#EEE7DC]只要你不主动开口，他们便对你的生活一无所知。而当你不在场时，他们的生活似乎也会停在原地。不会偶然相遇，不会私下联系，不会因为一句无心的话产生误会，也不会在你看不见的地方继续争吵、靠近或渐行渐远。[/color]

[color=#EEE7DC]你和他们明明住在同一个鹈鹕镇，却像生活在两个互不相通的平行世界。[/color]

[size=4][b][color=#E7BD72]《鹈鹕镇百闻本》想做的，就是把这两个世界重新接起来。[/color][/b][/size]

[color=#725D3E]·  ·  ·[/color]

[i][color=#AABBCD]You spend an entire day living on your farm. You chop trees in the morning, fish by the river in the afternoon, stop by the general store for a bag of seeds, and leave a gift in someone’s hands before heading home. You and the villagers walk the same roads, attend the same festivals, and sometimes spend an entire afternoon only a few steps apart. Yet the next morning, it can feel as though none of it ever happened.[/color][/i]

[i][color=#AABBCD]Unless you start the conversation, they know almost nothing about the life you have been living. And when you are not there to trigger an event, their lives seem to pause as well. They do not unexpectedly meet, call one another in private, misunderstand a careless remark, grow closer, argue, or drift apart somewhere beyond the farmer’s view.[/color][/i]

[i][color=#AABBCD]You all live in Pelican Town—yet sometimes it feels as though you inhabit two separate worlds.[/color][/i]

[i][color=#AABBCD]EAC LifeTraces was created to reconnect them.[/color][/i]



[color=#725D3E]· · ─────── ✦ ─────── · ·[/color]

[size=5][b][color=#D9A85D]✦  让他们真正看见你的生活  ✦[/color][/b][/size]

[b][color=#98AEC4]Let them truly see the life you live[/color][/b]

[color=#EEE7DC]从现在开始，你在鹈鹕镇度过的每一天，都可能在某个人心里留下痕迹。也许有一天，你在河边钓了整整一个下午，而恰好从桥上经过的居民，第二天依然记得曾在那里见过你。也许杂货店老板知道你买过什么，住在附近的人记得你来过，而收到礼物的人不会在转身之后立刻忘记那份心意。[/color]

[color=#EEE7DC]“我的生活”会记录你真正做过的事情：购物、砍树、钓鱼、采集、赶路、拜访、聊天与送礼，也会记下当时有哪些居民就在附近。但居民不会无缘无故知道你的一切。他们只会记住自己亲眼看见的事，或因为工作与身份合理得知的事。你也可以亲口告诉他们，既可以当面分享，也可以通过手机联系已经认识的人。[/color]

[color=#EEE7DC]到了夜晚，每个人真正知道的事情会被整理成属于自己的记忆。重复的日常会自然汇成“这几天常常”，而不是每天机械地留下同一句话。在你们真正认识之前，他们甚至未必知道你的名字。你可能只是“新来的农夫”，直到某一天，你的名字终于传进他们耳中。[/color]

[color=#725D3E]·  ·  ·[/color]

[i][color=#AABBCD]From now on, every day you spend in Pelican Town may leave a trace in someone’s memory. Perhaps you spend an entire afternoon fishing by the river, and a villager who happened to cross the bridge still remembers seeing you there the next day. Perhaps the shopkeeper remembers what you bought, a neighbor remembers your visit, and the person who received your gift does not forget the gesture the moment you walk away.[/color][/i]

[i][color=#AABBCD]“My Life” records what you genuinely did: shopping, chopping trees, fishing, gathering, travelling, visiting, talking, and giving gifts—as well as which villagers were actually nearby. But the villagers do not magically know everything about you. They only remember what they witnessed, what they could reasonably learn through their work or role, and what you chose to tell them—either face to face or by phone after you have met.[/color][/i]

[i][color=#AABBCD]At the end of the day, what each person genuinely knows is gathered into their own memory. Repeated routines can naturally become “something you have often done lately” instead of producing the same mechanical entry every day. Before you truly meet, they may not even know your name. To them, you might simply be “the new farmer”—until one day, your name finally reaches their ears.[/color][/i]



[color=#725D3E]· · ─────── ✦ ─────── · ·[/color]

[size=5][b][color=#D9A85D]✦  当你转身离开，他们的生活也不会暂停  ✦[/color][/b][/size]

[b][color=#98AEC4]When you walk away, their lives do not stop[/color][/b]

[color=#EEE7DC]居民会沿着自己的日程继续生活。只有真正待在同一个地方，或者确实通过手机取得联系的人，才可能留下一段新的故事。没有碰过面的人，不会被强行写成已经见过。他们可能只是聊了几句天气，也可能一起吃饭、借钱、还钱、产生误会、靠近彼此，或者因为一件压在心里很久的旧事终于爆发争吵。[/color]

[color=#EEE7DC]程序先确认真实发生的来往，再由 AI 根据人物的人格、关系、感受与过去经历，把它写成一段属于他们的故事。[/color]

[size=4][b][color=#E7BD72]生活先真实发生，AI只负责把它讲出来。[/color][/b][/size]

[color=#725D3E]·  ·  ·[/color]

[i][color=#AABBCD]The villagers continue living according to their own schedules. Only villagers who genuinely spend time in the same place—or actually contact one another by phone—can leave behind a new story. Characters who never met will not be forced into a scene together. They may only exchange a few words about the weather. Or they may share a meal, lend money, repay a debt, misunderstand one another, grow closer, or finally argue over something that has been buried for far too long.[/color][/i]

[i][color=#AABBCD]The mod confirms the real encounter first. AI then turns it into a story based on the characters’ personalities, relationships, feelings, and previous experiences.[/color][/i]

[i][color=#AABBCD]Life happens first. AI only tells the story.[/color][/i]



[color=#725D3E]· · ─────── ✦ ─────── · ·[/color]

[size=5][b][color=#D9A85D]✦  同一件事，会留在不同人的心里  ✦[/color][/b][/size]

[b][color=#98AEC4]The same event can live differently in every heart[/color][/b]

[color=#EEE7DC]一件事只有一个共同发生过的事实，却未必会在每个人心里留下相同的答案。有人后悔，有人嘴硬；有人以为自己赢了，也有人明明受了伤，却假装什么都不在乎。他们可以隐瞒、自欺、误解，也可以在之后的相处中重新看待那一天。[/color]

[color=#EEE7DC]这些感受会分别写回 EAC，成为之后对话、关系与选择的一部分。[/color]

[color=#725D3E]·  ·  ·[/color]

[i][color=#AABBCD]An event has one shared reality, but it does not have to leave the same answer in every heart. Someone may regret it. Someone else may refuse to admit what it meant. One person may believe they won, while another pretends not to care despite being deeply hurt. They may hide the truth, deceive themselves, misunderstand what happened, or come to see that day differently after future encounters.[/color][/i]

[i][color=#AABBCD]These memories and feelings are written back into EAC, becoming part of future conversations, relationships, and choices.[/color][/i]



[color=#725D3E]· · ─────── ✦ ─────── · ·[/color]

[size=5][b][color=#D9A85D]✦  有些故事，不会立刻把真相交给你  ✦[/color][/b][/size]

[b][color=#98AEC4]Some stories will not hand you the truth immediately[/color][/b]

[color=#EEE7DC]有些事情发生在你看不见的地方，只会先在百闻本里露出一点线索。也许是某个人说漏嘴的一句话，也许是你后来走到那里时发现的一处痕迹。你需要在之后的生活中慢慢靠近真相，把“在哪里”“是谁”“发生了什么”与“后来怎样”一点点拼起来。[/color]

[color=#EEE7DC]线索不会永远等在那里。它们可能随着时间慢慢淡去，而镇口的“今日有瓜”会在重要线索即将消失时提醒你。如果你不想调查，只想直接看热闹，也可以打开“上帝视角”。[/color]

[color=#725D3E]·  ·  ·[/color]

[i][color=#AABBCD]Some things happen beyond your sight and reveal only a small clue in the Chronicle. It may be a sentence someone accidentally lets slip, or a trace you notice when you later visit the area. You must move closer to the truth through everyday life, gradually piecing together where it happened, who was involved, what occurred, and what followed.[/color][/i]

[i][color=#AABBCD]Clues will not wait forever. They may fade with time, while the town notice board warns you when an important piece of gossip is about to disappear. If you would rather skip the investigation and enjoy the full story immediately, a God View option is also available.[/color][/i]



[color=#725D3E]· · ─────── ✦ ─────── · ·[/color]

[size=5][b][color=#D9A85D]✦  一句话传过几个人以后，还是原来的意思吗？  ✦[/color][/b][/size]

[b][color=#98AEC4]After passing through several people, is it still the same story?[/color][/b]

[color=#EEE7DC]旁边的人看见了一件事，就可能成为一条流言的起点。可一句话从不同人的嘴里走过，往往会慢慢变成另一副模样。有人只说自己看见的部分，有人遗漏了关键前因，也有人会按照自己的性格和立场添上一点想象。[/color]

[color=#EEE7DC]如果流言传进当事人耳中，他们也会有自己的反应。你可以在“镇上”页面看见一条消息传到了谁、又被说成了什么样。你也可以亲自加入其中：传播、澄清，或者再添一点油、加一点醋。[/color]

[color=#725D3E]·  ·  ·[/color]

[i][color=#AABBCD]When someone witnesses an event, they may become the beginning of a rumor. But when a story passes from one person to another, it rarely remains unchanged. Someone may repeat only what they saw. Someone may leave out an important detail. Someone else may add a little imagination shaped by their own personality and point of view.[/color][/i]

[i][color=#AABBCD]And if the rumor reaches the people involved, they will have reactions of their own. On the Town page, you can see who has heard a rumor and how the story changed along the way. You may also join in—spread it, correct it, or add a little more fuel to the fire.[/color][/i]



[color=#725D3E]· · ─────── ✦ ─────── · ·[/color]

[size=5][b][color=#D9A85D]✦  秘密不会永远安静，旧账也不会凭空消失  ✦[/color][/b][/size]

[b][color=#98AEC4]Secrets do not stay quiet forever, and old wounds do not simply vanish[/color][/b]

[color=#EEE7DC]居民之间会逐渐积累秘密、心事、欠下的人情、没有说出口的不满，以及已经传开的流言。当张力终于越过某条界线，一场真正的风波便可能爆发。谁会争吵，谁会退让，谁会冲上去插手，谁又只站在旁边看热闹，都取决于他们各自的性格、关系与当时的处境。[/color]

[color=#EEE7DC]而争吵之后，也没有一份提前写好的标准答案。他们可能和好，可能留下更深的裂痕，也可能表面若无其事，心里却悄悄记下了新的一笔。[/color]

[color=#725D3E]·  ·  ·[/color]

[i][color=#AABBCD]Secrets, unspoken feelings, debts, resentment, and rumors can slowly accumulate between villagers. When that tension finally crosses a line, a real conflict may erupt. Who argues, who backs down, who steps in, and who merely watches depends on each character’s personality, relationships, and circumstances.[/color][/i]

[i][color=#AABBCD]And there is no predetermined answer for what happens afterward. They may reconcile, leave behind a deeper wound, or act as though nothing happened while quietly remembering every word.[/color][/i]



[color=#725D3E]· · ─────── ✦ ─────── · ·[/color]

[size=5][b][color=#D9A85D]✦  这一次，你也可以成为故事里真正的人  ✦[/color][/b][/size]

[b][color=#98AEC4]This time, you can become a real person within the story[/color][/b]

[color=#EEE7DC]“关于我”允许你用 EAC 人格卡的方式，为游戏中的自己写下一份人设。你不再只是一个没有性格、没有立场，等待 NPC 回应的空白角色。你可以记录自己对每位居民的关系与感受，也能看见他们如何在真实相处中逐渐改变对你的看法。[/color]

[color=#EEE7DC]你还可以亲手写下一件属于自己的事：什么时候、在哪里、和谁、发生了什么。AI 会先按照你的人设将它扩写成预览。只有你确认满意，它才会正式进入记忆。如果后来觉得不合适，也可以撤回。与这件事相关的记忆、感受和关系变化会一并还原。[/color]

[color=#725D3E]·  ·  ·[/color]

[i][color=#AABBCD]“About Me” allows you to create a persona for your farmer using the EAC character-card format. You no longer have to be an empty protagonist with no personality, boundaries, or point of view. You can record your own feelings and relationships with each villager, while watching their opinions of you change through real interactions.[/color][/i]

[i][color=#AABBCD]You may also record an event of your own: when it happened, where it happened, who was there, and what took place. AI creates a preview based on your persona first. Nothing enters memory until you approve it. If you later change your mind, the event can be withdrawn together with the memories, feelings, and relationship changes it created.[/color][/i]



[color=#725D3E]· · ─────── ✦ ─────── · ·[/color]

[size=5][b][color=#D9A85D]✦  打开百闻本，看看今天的鹈鹕镇  ✦[/color][/b][/size]

[b][color=#98AEC4]Open the Chronicle and see what happened today[/color][/b]

[color=#EEE7DC]每段居民故事都有自己的详情页。你可以看到事情发生的情境、对话与动作、当时在场的人，以及每位参与者事后的看法。你也可以知道自己为什么会看到这件事，并把喜欢的故事导出成长图保存。百闻本可以通过快捷键、时钟旁的小本子、社交页面、挂墙家具或镇口告示牌打开。[/color]

[size=4][b][color=#E7BD72]但请拿稳一些。[/color][/b][/size]

[color=#EEE7DC]如果弄丢了，八卦之神愿意收下一万金，并在第二天寄来一本新的——至于同情，恐怕不在服务范围内。[/color]

[color=#725D3E]·  ·  ·[/color]

[i][color=#AABBCD]Every resident story has its own detail page, showing the setting, dialogue, actions, witnesses, and each participant’s thoughts afterward. You can also see how the farmer learned about the event and export favorite stories as long images. The Chronicle can be opened through a hotkey, the notebook beside the clock, the social page, the wall-mounted journal, or the town notice board.[/color][/i]

[i][color=#AABBCD]Just make sure you do not lose it.[/color][/i]

[i][color=#AABBCD]If you lose it, the God of Gossip will gladly accept 10,000g and mail you a new copy the following morning. Sympathy, however, is not included in the service.[/color][/i]



[color=#725D3E]· · ─────── ✦ ─────── · ·[/color]

[size=5][b][color=#D9A85D]✦  可选的成人内容  ✦[/color][/b][/size]

[b][color=#98AEC4]Optional adult content[/color][/b]

[color=#EEE7DC]本模组包含可选的成人事件系统，默认开启，也可以在设置中完整关闭。程序会先检查年龄、关系、配对限制、冷却时间、每日上限与其他资格条件。未成年角色不会进入成人事件，儿童也不会收到相关秘密。[/color]

[color=#EEE7DC]通过这些规则，并不代表事件一定会发生。AI 仍会根据人物设定、彼此关系、当前感受与当天真实来往作出判断，不会为了触发功能而强行配对。设置中提供恋爱模式、禁止配对、同性关系、跨辈关系、多人事件与亲属关系类别等独立控制项。[/color]

[color=#EEE7DC]请按照自己的接受程度调整设置，并留意所使用 AI 服务商的内容政策。[/color]

[color=#725D3E]·  ·  ·[/color]

[i][color=#AABBCD]The mod includes an optional adult-event system. It is enabled by default and can be disabled entirely in the settings. Program-level checks handle age, relationships, blocked pairings, cooldowns, daily limits, and other eligibility rules. Minors are excluded from adult events, and related secrets are not shared with children.[/color][/i]

[i][color=#AABBCD]Passing these checks does not guarantee that an event will happen. AI still considers the characters, their relationship, current feelings, and actual contact that day. The system will not force a pairing simply because the feature is enabled. Separate controls are available for relationship modes, blocked pairings, same-gender relationships, age-gap relationships, multi-person events, and family-relation categories.[/color][/i]

[i][color=#AABBCD]Please configure these options according to your own preferences and the content policy of your AI provider.[/color][/i]



[color=#725D3E]· · ─────── ✦ ─────── · ·[/color]

[size=5][b][color=#D9A85D]✦  AI 调用与费用  ✦[/color][/b][/size]

[b][color=#98AEC4]AI usage and cost[/color][/b]

[color=#EEE7DC]“我的生活”记录玩家的普通行动、判断谁真正看见了你，并在聊天时向 EAC 提供对方已经知道的信息。这些功能本身不会调用 AI。“居民生活”需要使用玩家自行配置的 AI 接口，并可能产生费用。[/color]

[color=#EEE7DC]模组会把一段时间内真实发生的多组来往合并成批次发送。你可以在设置中调整检查间隔、每批组数、每日数量与相关输出。调用越频繁、生成内容越长，费用就可能越高。请根据自己使用的接口价格合理设置，并留意账户余额。[/color]

[color=#EEE7DC]“回应分享”等额外功能会单独调用 AI，默认关闭。[/color]

[color=#725D3E]·  ·  ·[/color]

[i][color=#AABBCD]“My Life” records the farmer’s ordinary actions, determines who genuinely witnessed them, and provides existing knowledge to EAC during conversations. These features do not call AI by themselves. “Resident Life” uses the AI service configured by the player and may incur charges.[/color][/i]

[i][color=#AABBCD]The mod batches multiple confirmed encounters into AI requests. You can adjust the interval, groups per batch, daily limits, and related output settings. More frequent calls and longer output may cost more. Please review the pricing of your chosen provider, configure the mod accordingly, and monitor your balance.[/color][/i]

[i][color=#AABBCD]Optional features such as immediate responses to shared information require separate AI calls and are disabled by default.[/color][/i]



[color=#725D3E]· · ─────── ✦ ─────── · ·[/color]

[size=5][b][color=#D9A85D]✦  可选联动  ✦[/color][/b][/size]

[b][color=#98AEC4]Optional integrations[/color][/b]

[color=#EEE7DC]居民银行 / EAC Bank

故事中的借钱、还钱与请客，可以产生实际的金钱变化。

居民心愿单 / EAC Wish List

故事中出现的愿望，可以被写进居民心愿单。

EAC 看电影 / EAC Movie Night

居民可以在故事中谈到镇上正在放映的电影。

可以读取居民在百闻本中真实经历过的事情。

部分可选联动目前尚未完成充分的公开环境实机验证。使用前请备份存档，也欢迎反馈遇到的问题。[/color]

[color=#725D3E]·  ·  ·[/color]

[i][color=#AABBCD]Loans, repayments, and shared meals in resident stories can produce real financial changes.

Wishes that emerge from stories can be added to a villager’s wish list.

Villagers can refer to movies currently being shown in town.

EAC EventMaker

EventMaker can read experiences recorded by the Chronicle.

Some optional integrations have not yet received extensive public-environment testing. Please back up your save before using them, and feel free to report any issues.[/color][/i]



[color=#725D3E]· · ─────── ✦ ─────── · ·[/color]

[size=5][b][color=#D9A85D]✦  安装方法  ✦[/color][/b][/size]

[b][color=#98AEC4]Installation[/color][/b]

[color=#EEE7DC]1. 安装 SMAPI 4.0.0 或更高版本。

2. 安装 Evolving AI Conversation 3.13.0 或更高版本。

3. 下载并解压本模组。

4. 将解压得到的 LifeTraces 文件夹放入：

5. 启动游戏，并按照首次使用窗口完成设置。

更新时，请先退出游戏，再使用新版本覆盖原来的 LifeTraces 文件夹。[/color]

[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][color=#725D3E]·  ·  ·[/color]

[i][color=#AABBCD]Install SMAPI 4.0.0 or later.

Install Evolving AI Conversation 3.13.0 or later.

Download and extract this mod.

Place the extracted LifeTraces folder inside:

Start the game and follow the first-use setup window.

When updating, close the game first and replace the existing LifeTraces folder with the new version.[/color][/i]



[color=#725D3E]· · ─────── ✦ ─────── · ·[/color]

[size=5][b][color=#D9A85D]✦  使用前请注意  ✦[/color][/b][/size]

[b][color=#98AEC4]Before you begin[/color][/b]

[color=#EEE7DC]• 本模组是 EAC（Evolving AI Conversation）的附属模组，不能脱离 EAC 单独运行。

• 目前仅支持单人游戏。

• 游戏内界面目前仅提供中文。
